parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS tid, t.code, t.name AS tname, t.sport, t.status, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.registration_deadline, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS deadline, (t.registration_deadline < CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', '+05:30')) AS closed, tm.id AS team_id, tm.code AS team_code, tm.name AS team_name, tm.short_name, e.id AS entry_id, e.status AS estatus, d.name AS dname, d.min_age, d.max_age, d.squad_max, d.match_rules, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, u.birthdate, t.start_date) AS my_age, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('name', COALESCE(pu.name, x.guest_name), 'role', x.role, 'position', x.position))  FROM tournament_entry_players ep JOIN team_members x ON x.id = ep.team_member_id LEFT JOIN app_users pu ON pu.id = x.user_id  WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id AND x.status = 'ACTIVE') AS squad, u.id AS uid, u.profile_complete, (u.photo_key IS NOT NULL) AS has_photo, u.name IS NULL AS no_name, u.birthdate IS NULL AS no_birthdate, u.gender IS NULL AS no_gender, u.jersey_name IS NULL AS no_jersey_name, u.jersey_number IS NULL AS no_jersey_number, u.jersey_size IS NULL AS no_jersey_size, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user_sports s WHERE s.user_id = u.id AND s.sport = t.sport) AS has_sport, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id AND ep.user_id = u.id) AS in_squad, (SELECT x.status FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = tm.id AND x.user_id = u.id) AS my_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = tm.id AND x.status = 'PENDING') AS waiting, COALESCE((SELECT ot.name FROM tournament_entry_players ep JOIN tournament_entries oe ON oe.id = ep.entry_id JOIN teams ot ON ot.id = oe.team_id  WHERE ep.tournament_id = t.id AND ep.user_id = u.id AND oe.id <> e.id LIMIT 1),  (SELECT ot.name FROM team_members x JOIN teams ot ON ot.id = x.team_id JOIN tournament_entries oe ON oe.team_id = ot.id AND oe.tournament_id = t.id   WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND x.status = 'PENDING' AND ot.id <> tm.id LIMIT 1)) AS other_team FROM tournaments t JOIN teams tm ON tm.code = $2 LEFT JOIN tournament_entries e ON e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.team_id = tm.id AND e.status IN ('PENDING', 'WAITLISTED', 'APPROVED') LEFT JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = e.division_id LEFT JOIN app_users u ON u.phone = $3 WHERE t.code = $1 AND t.kind = 'TOURNAMENT' AND t.status <> 'DRAFT'
